scientific_integrity: Algebraic moment proof and global monotonicity optimizer argument; symbolic and independent finite numerical reproducibility tests; originality remains subject to residual priority risk.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three bosonic modes, selective central pure dephasing and symmetric thermal Lindblad end baths; excitation number current rather than thermodynamic heat current. Infinite-dimensional state uniqueness and experimental robustness are not asserted.
title: A sharp dephasing-assistance threshold for thermally driven bosonic number transport
